correctness.rationale: From u_n=2b_n+1 and α=3+2√2, β=α^{-1}, the homogeneous recurrence gives u_n=Aα^n+Bβ^n with AB=1/8. Expanding b_n² produces a constant 5/16 and four ±1/±2 exponential modes. For odd p, α±1 and α±2 denominators are units; for p≥11 five distinct modes give an invertible Vandermonde modulo p. Thus all windows vanish mod p exactly when p|k and r_p|k, and lifting S_k(α^j) gives nonconstant modes one extra p-adic digit so ν_p(G)=ν_p(k). At p=5, r5=6 and α^6−1=5(3920+2772√2) has exact valuation 1, yielding the extra factor. The p=3 and 7 periodic b_n² sequences give 12|k and 21|k conditions; the p=2 matrix C^4=I+2K and doubling prove the dyadic block valuation max(2,1+ν2(k)). Independent exact integer GCDs of first eight genuine window sums at 17 selected k (including k=6,12,21,30,84,120) match the proposed product. These finite checks do not establish all-window or all-k claims, which follow from the five-mode/Vandermonde and dyadic induction.
